caption: Spike, cursor set inside the table text.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:4,ch:3}); l.view.editor.focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return 'ok'; })()
